spec.description:
Lists the MetricsHub agents feeding this dashboard.

Version, Build Date, Build Number: version and build of the agent.

Connectors Version: version of the connectors library used by the agent.

Last Seen: last time the agent reported metrics. An agent that has not been seen recently means its GPUs are no longer being monitored.

spec.expr:
topk by (agent_host_name) (
  1,
  last_over_time(timestamp(metricshub_agent_info)[6h:])
)

spec.title: Dashboard Version
spec.description: Version of this dashboard.

spec.title: Critical
spec.description: Number of critical issues currently affecting the GPUs: firing critical alerts, plus failed NVSwitch chips and NVLink ports, plus GPUs with a failed NVIDIA health check.

spec.expr:
(
  count(ALERTS{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", alertstate="firing", severity="critical", alertname=~"MetricsHub-(GPU|Hardware).*", alertname!~"MetricsHub-Hardware-Device-Status-.*", host_name=~"$model_hosts"})
  or vector(0)
)
+ on()
(
  sum(
    max by (host_name, id) (
      hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="failed"} == 1
    )
  )
  or vector(0)
)
+ on()
(
  sum(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="failed"} == 1)
  or vector(0)
)
+ on()
(
  sum(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="failed"} == 1)
  or vector(0)
)

spec.title: Warning
spec.description: Number of warning-level issues currently affecting the GPUs: firing warning alerts, plus NVSwitch chips and NVLink ports that are degraded or predicted to fail, plus GPUs with a degraded NVIDIA health check.

spec.title: Needs Recovery
spec.description:
Number of GPUs that need an action before they can work properly again, such as a GPU reset or a reboot of the server. The GPU reports this itself.

N/A means the connector does not publish this yet.

spec.expr:
(
count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state!="none"}) == 1)
or (0 * count(hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}))
)
and on () (count(hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"} @ end()) > 0)

spec.title: Unhealthy GPUs
spec.description:
GPUs reporting a problem right now, one row per problem, worst first. Healthy GPUs are not listed.

MIG: the MIG instance, when the problem is reported on one.

Check: the NVIDIA health check that is not OK, such as fabric, memory or thermal, or the recovery action the GPU asks for.

Status: Failed or Degraded for a health check, or what the GPU needs before it works properly again, such as a reset or a reboot.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, id, hw_gpu_subsystem) (
    2 * (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="failed"} == 1)
    or (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"} == 1)
  )
  or
  label_replace(
    max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, id) (
      (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="gpu-reset"} == 1) + 10
      or (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="node-reboot"} == 1) + 11
      or (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="drain-p2p"} == 1) + 12
      or (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="drain-and-reset"} == 1) + 13
      or (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="recover-imex-domain"} == 1) + 14
      or (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="bus-reset"} == 1) + 15
      or (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="system-reboot"} == 1) + 16
      or (hw_gpu_recovery_action{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="unknown"} == 1) + 17
    ),
    "hw_gpu_subsystem", "recovery", "", ""
  ),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

links.title: Click to see the GPU dashboard

spec.description: Live list of the alerts currently firing on the GPUs, NVSwitch chips and NVLink ports.

spec.title: GPUs
spec.description: Total number of monitored physical GPUs. Partitioned slices of a GPU are counted separately, under MIG Instances.

spec.expr: count(count by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}))

spec.title: MIG Instances
spec.description: Number of MIG instances. A GPU can be split into isolated slices so that several jobs can share it, and each slice is counted here.

spec.expr:
count(count by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}))
or vector(0)

spec.title: Telemetry Coverage
spec.description:
Share of the GPUs seen in the last 24 hours that are reporting utilization, temperature and power right now.

Below 100% means some GPUs stopped reporting, or never send part of their data, so the fleet figures leave them out. A server that goes silent lowers this figure for a day.

spec.expr:
(
  count(
    count by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"})
    and on (host_name, id)
    count by (host_name, id) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", sensor_location="gpu", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})
    and on (host_name, id)
    count by (host_name, id) (hw_power_watts{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})
  )
  or vector(0)
)
/
count(count by (host_name, id) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}[1d])))

spec.title: Busy GPUs
spec.description: Number of GPUs doing work right now, meaning above 5% utilization.

spec.expr:
count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}) > 0.05)
or vector(0)

spec.title: Idle GPUs
spec.description:
Number of GPUs at or below 5% utilization.

Idle GPUs still draw power and cost the same, so a high count is capacity that could be given to another job.

spec.expr:
count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}) <= 0.05)
or vector(0)

spec.title: Throttled GPUs
spec.description:
Number of GPUs that had to slow down their clocks during the selected period, because they ran too hot or because the server cut their power.

A throttled GPU runs jobs slower than it should. Time held at the power limit is not counted here.

spec.title: Fleet Utilization
spec.description:
GPU utilization over time across the fleet: the average, the busiest GPU and the quietest GPU.

A wide gap between them means the work is unevenly spread.

spec.expr: avg(hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"})
max(hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"})
min(hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"})

spec.title: GPUs by Model
spec.description: Number of monitored GPUs per model.

spec.expr: count by (hw_gpu_model) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})

spec.title: Total Power
spec.description: Power currently drawn by all monitored GPUs together.

spec.expr:
sum(hw_power_watts{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})
or vector(0)

spec.title: Energy
spec.description: Energy consumed by all monitored GPUs over the selected period.

spec.expr:
sum(increase(hw_energy_joules_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}[$__range])) / 3600000
or vector(0)

spec.description:
Every monitored GPU and MIG instance, busiest first.

GPU Utilization: share of time the GPU was doing work.

Utilization Trend: GPU utilization over the selected period.

Memory Utilization: share of the GPU's memory in use.

Temperature: GPU temperature, from blue at 30 °C to red at 90 °C.

Headroom: degrees left before the GPU reaches its maximum operating temperature, where it can start slowing itself down. Orange under 10 °C, red under 5 °C.

Power: power currently drawn.

Perf. State: how fast the GPU is set to run, from Max down to Idle. Reduced on a busy GPU means something is holding it back.

XID Errors: number of faults reported by the NVIDIA driver over the selected period.

Time Throttled: time the GPU spent slowed down by heat or by the server cutting its power, over the selected period. The three reasons are added up, so a minute slowed down for two reasons at once counts as two minutes.

N/A: the GPU sends no value for that column, for example a figure the connector does not publish yet.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

max by (id) (label_join(
  max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
))

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_gpu_memory_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", sensor_location="gpu"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_power_watts{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_gpu_performance_state_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type="xid"}[$__range])) or (0 * max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (increase(hw_gpu_throttle_time_seconds_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_throttle_reason=~"hardware-thermal|software-thermal|hardware-power-brake"}[$__range])) or (0 * max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id, hw_gpu_pci_bus_id, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

links.title: Click to see the GPU dashboard

spec.title: Utilization by Engine
spec.description:
Average utilization across the fleet for each part of the GPU: the general compute cores, the tensor cores used for AI, memory transfers and video encoding.

It shows what kind of work the fleet is doing.

spec.expr: avg by (hw_gpu_task) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: GPU memory in use across the fleet over time, and the average share of memory used per GPU.

spec.expr: sum(hw_gpu_memory_usage_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_memory_state="used"})
sum(hw_gpu_memory_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})
avg(hw_gpu_memory_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})

spec.title: Temperature
spec.description:
Hottest and average GPU temperature over time, against the lowest limits in the selection.

Above the lower limit a GPU may slow itself down. At the upper limit the hardware cuts its clocks.

spec.expr: max(hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", sensor_location="gpu"})
avg(hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", sensor_location="gpu"})

min(hw_temperature_limit_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", sensor_location="gpu", limit_type="high.degraded"})

min(hw_temperature_limit_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", sensor_location="gpu", limit_type="high.critical"})

spec.title: Top GPUs by Utilization
spec.description: The 10 busiest GPUs right now, by utilization.

spec.expr: topk(10, hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"})

spec.title: Top GPUs by Memory Utilization
spec.description: The 10 GPUs using the largest share of their own memory right now.

spec.expr: topk(10, hw_gpu_memory_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})

spec.title: Top GPUs by Power
spec.description: The 10 GPUs drawing the most power right now, as a share of their own power limit.

spec.title: NVSwitches
spec.description: Number of monitored NVSwitch chips. They connect the GPUs inside a server so that they can exchange data at full speed.

spec.expr:
count(count by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="other_device", device_type="NVSwitch", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="present"}))
or vector(0)

spec.title: NVLink Ports Down
spec.description:
Number of NVLink connections between a GPU and an NVSwitch that are down.

A GPU with a link down keeps working but exchanges data with the others more slowly.

spec.expr:
count(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"} == 0)
or vector(0)

spec.title: Fabric Issues
spec.description: Number of GPUs reporting a problem with the NVLink fabric, such as reduced bandwidth or a configuration error.

spec.title: NVLink Traffic
spec.description: Data exchanged between GPUs over NVLink across the fleet, split between data sent and data received.

spec.expr: sum by (direction) (rate(hw_gpu_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", interface="nvlink"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: PCIe Traffic
spec.description: Data exchanged between the GPUs and the rest of their server over PCIe, split between data sent and data received.

spec.expr: sum by (direction) (rate(hw_gpu_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", interface="pcie"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: Interconnect Errors
spec.description:
Error rate on the NVLink and PCIe connections, by type of error.

Occasional errors that the hardware corrects are normal. A rising trend points to a failing link, port or GPU.

spec.expr: sum by (hw_error_type) (rate(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type=~"nvlink-.*|pcie-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (hw_error_type) (rate(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description:
Every NVLink connection between an NVSwitch and a GPU. Links that are down come first, then ports with errors, then the busiest.

Port: the NVSwitch port, and the GPU and link at its other end.

Link: whether the connection is up.

Traffic: data currently going through the port in its busier direction, so that it compares with Bandwidth. Not reported means the port has no traffic counter.

Bandwidth: maximum speed of the connection in one direction. N/A when the port does not report it.

Utilization: Traffic as a share of Bandwidth. Near 100% the link is saturated and holds back the jobs that use it. N/A means the bandwidth or the traffic of the link is not known.

Errors: number of transmission errors on the port over the selected period. Not reported means the port has no error counter.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  max by (host_name, name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}[$__rate_interval]))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}) - 1),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="network", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}[$__range]))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}) - 1),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, id) (rate(hw_network_io_bytes_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}[$__rate_interval]))
  /
  max by (host_name, id) (hw_network_bandwidth_limit_bytes{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"} > 0),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

value.title: Open the NVLink fabric of this server

spec.title: ECC Errors
spec.description:
Rate of memory errors detected on the GPUs, split between corrected and uncorrected.

Corrected errors are fixed by the GPU and are routine in small numbers. Uncorrected errors can crash a job and mean the memory needs attention.

spec.expr: sum by (hw_error_type) (rate(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type=~"ecc-memory-.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.title: XID Errors
spec.description:
XID errors per minute on each host. The XID Errors column of the GPU table gives the total over the selected period.

XID errors are faults reported by the NVIDIA driver. Most are a crashed job, some point to a failing GPU.

spec.expr: sum by (host_name) (rate(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type="xid"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60

spec.title: Throttle Time by Reason
spec.description:
Average number of GPUs running below full speed at any moment, by reason: heat, power limit, hardware slowdown and so on.

0.5 means one GPU held back half the time, or two GPUs a quarter of the time. A GPU can be held back for several reasons at once, so the lines do not add up to a total.

low-utilization means the GPU had little work to do and lowered its clocks. That is normal.

The GPUs update these counters on their own schedule, so a short window can read a little more than the time elapsed. Each GPU counts for at most 1, held back the whole time.

spec.expr: sum by (hw_gpu_throttle_reason) (clamp_max(rate(hw_gpu_throttle_time_seconds_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}[$__rate_interval]), 1))

spec.title: Memory Health
spec.description:
GPUs showing signs of memory wear. A GPU is only listed once it has had to repair its memory, or once its spare capacity starts to run out.

Remapped Rows: memory rows the GPU has replaced with spares after errors.

Uncorrected Rows: rows replaced after errors the GPU could not correct.

Banks at Max: memory banks that still have all their spare rows.

Banks Low: memory banks with few spare rows left.

Banks at None: memory banks with no spare rows left. Further errors there cannot be repaired.

Conditions: memory problems the GPU is currently reporting.

N/A: the GPU sends no value for that column, for example a figure the connector does not publish yet.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_count{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_count{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type="ecc-memory-uncorrected"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_bank_count{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_availability="max"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_bank_count{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_availability="low"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_bank_count{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_memory_row_remap_availability="none"}),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_gpu_memory_condition_active_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"} == bool 1),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

spec.title: Hottest GPU Memory
spec.description:
Temperature of the hottest GPU memory in the fleet. GPU memory has its own temperature, separate from the GPU itself, and can overheat while the GPU looks fine.

The GPUs do not report a limit for their memory, so the color goes from blue at 30 °C to red at 95 °C, the usual limit for GPU memory.

spec.expr: max(hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", sensor_location="gpu-memory", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})

spec.title: Degraded PCIe Links
spec.description:
Number of GPUs whose PCIe connection to the server runs narrower or slower than it can. A GPU in that state loses bandwidth to the rest of the server without reporting an error.

A slower link only counts while the GPU is busy, because many GPUs slow their link down when idle to save power.

N/A means the connector does not publish PCIe link figures.

spec.expr:
count(
  (
    max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_pcie_link_width{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})
    < on (host_name, id)
    max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_pcie_link_width_limit{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$model_hosts"})
  )
  or
  (
    max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_pcie_link_generation_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"})
    < on (host_name, id)
    max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_pcie_link_generation_limit_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$model_hosts"})
    and on (host_name, id)
    max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_task="general", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}) > 0.05
  )
)
or (0 * count(hw_gpu_pcie_link_width{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}))

spec.title: Driver Versions
spec.description:
Number of different NVIDIA driver versions running across the fleet. More than one usually means a host was missed during an upgrade, a common reason for jobs to fail on some hosts and not others.

N/A means no GPU reports its driver version, for example when the exporter's counters file leaves it out.

spec.expr: count(count by (driver_version) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", state="present", driver_version!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}))

spec.title: Energy Cost
spec.description:
Cost of the electricity used by the GPUs over the selected period, at each site's electricity price, including the cooling and power losses the site's PUE accounts for.

GPUs at a site with no electricity price configured are left out.

spec.expr:
sum(
  sum by (site) (increase(hw_energy_joules_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}[$__range]))
  * on (site) group_left () avg by (site) (avg_over_time(hw_site_pue_ratio[$__range]))
  * on (site) group_left () avg by (site) (avg_over_time(hw_site_electricity_cost[$__range]))
) / 3600 / 1000

spec.title: CO₂ Emissions
spec.description:
Carbon emitted to power the GPUs over the selected period, from each site's live carbon intensity, including the cooling and power losses the site's PUE accounts for.

GPUs at a site with no carbon intensity configured are left out.

spec.expr:
sum(
  sum by (site) (increase(hw_energy_joules_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}[$__range]))
  * on (site) group_left () avg by (site) (avg_over_time(hw_site_pue_ratio[$__range]))
  * on (site) group_left () avg by (site) (avg_over_time(hw_site_carbon_intensity_grams[$__range]))
) / 3600 / 1000 / 1000

spec.title: Utilization by Model
spec.description:
Average GPU utilization over time for each GPU model.

A model that sits well below the others is worth a look: its jobs may not suit it, or little work is scheduled on it.

spec.expr: avg by (hw_gpu_model) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"})

spec.title: GPU Errors
spec.description:
GPUs that reported errors during the selected period, most serious first. GPUs without errors are not listed.

ECC Uncorrected: memory errors the GPU could not correct. They can crash a job, and a GPU that keeps reporting them needs attention.

ECC Corrected: memory errors the GPU corrected. A few are routine. A rising count points to failing memory.

XID: faults reported by the NVIDIA driver. Most are a crashed job, some point to a failing GPU.

NVLink: transmission errors on the GPU's NVLink connections.

PCIe: transmission errors on the GPU's PCIe connection.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type="ecc-memory-uncorrected"}[$__range]))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type="ecc-memory-corrected"}[$__range]))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type="xid"}[$__range]))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type=~"nvlink-.*"}[$__range]))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (increase(hw_errors_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_error_type=~"pcie-.*"}[$__range]))
  or (0 * max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"})),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

spec.title: GPUs Not Reporting
spec.description:
Hosts where GPUs stopped reporting, or where the agent cannot read the GPU data. Hosts that report normally are not listed.

Expected GPUs: GPUs the host reported during the last day.

Reporting GPUs: GPUs that report now.

Missing GPUs: GPUs the host reported during the last day that report nothing now.

Connector: state of the NVIDIA connector on the host. Failed means the agent cannot read the GPU data.

Exporter: whether the agent can reach the NVIDIA exporter on the host.

N/A: the agent sends nothing for that host.

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  count by (host_name) (
    count by (host_name, id) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}[1d]))
    unless on (host_name, id)
    (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"} == 1)
  )
  or (0 * count by (host_name) (count by (host_name, id) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}[1d])))),
  "id", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)"
)

label_replace(
  count by (host_name) (count by (host_name, id) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}[1d]))),
  "id", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)"
)

label_replace(
  max by (host_name) (metricshub_connector_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="failed"}),
  "id", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)"
)

label_replace(
  min by (host_name) (metricshub_host_up{protocol="http", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}),
  "id", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)"
)

label_replace(
  count by (host_name) (max by (host_name, id) (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}) == 1)
  or (0 * count by (host_name) (count by (host_name, id) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem="", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="present"}[1d])))),
  "id", "$1", "host_name", "(.*)"
)

spec.title: Health Over Time
spec.description: When a GPU health check, an NVSwitch or an NVLink port degraded or failed, and for how long. Only the ones that were not OK at some point of the selected period are drawn. Everything stayed OK needs health checks or fabric status from the GPUs. Without them, a gray No health checks reported line shows instead.

spec.expr:
max by (host_name, id, name, hw_gpu_subsystem) (
  2 * ((max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="failed"}[$__interval]) or hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="failed"}) == 1)
  or ((max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"}[$__interval]) or hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"}) == 1)
  or 0 * (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state="ok"} == 1)
)
and on (host_name, id, name, hw_gpu_subsystem)
(
  max by (host_name, id, name, hw_gpu_subsystem) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_subsystem!="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", state=~"failed|degraded|predicted_failure"}[$__range] @ end())) == 1
)

label_replace(
max by (host_name, id, name) (
  2 * ((max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="failed"}[$__interval]) or hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="failed"}) == 1)
  or ((max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"}[$__interval]) or hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"}) == 1)
  or 0 * (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="ok"} == 1)
)
and on (host_name, id, name)
(
  max by (host_name, id, name) (max_over_time(hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state=~"failed|degraded|predicted_failure"}[$__range] @ end())) == 1
),
  "name", "$1 to GPU $2", "name", "(NVSwitch [0-9]+ port [0-9]+) \\(GPU ([0-9]+) link [0-9]+\\)"
)

spec.title: GPUs Idle All Period
spec.description:
GPUs that did no work during the selected period: their utilization never went above 5%. Check the workload and its reservation before giving one of them to someone else or buying more GPUs. GPUs that worked at some point are not listed.

Peak Utilization: the highest utilization the GPU reached in the period.

Memory Held: average share of its memory in use. A high value means a job holds the GPU without using it. A low one means nobody uses it.

Energy: energy the GPU drew during the period.

spec.expr:
label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (max_over_time(hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}[$__range])) <= 0.05,
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  max by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (avg_over_time(hw_gpu_memory_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}[$__range]))
  and on (host_name, id) (max by (host_name, id) (max_over_time(hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}[$__range])) <= 0.05),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

label_join(
  sum by (host_name, hw_gpu_index, hw_gpu_model, id) (increase(hw_energy_joules_total{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type="gpu", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model"}[$__range])) / 3600000
  and on (host_name, id) (max by (host_name, id) (max_over_time(hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}[$__range])) <= 0.05),
  "id", "/", "host_name", "id"
)

spec.title: GPUs by Utilization
spec.description:
Number of GPUs in each utilization band over time: idle up to 5%, light up to 50%, busy up to 90%, saturated above 90%.

A fleet that spends time saturated is short of GPUs. A wide idle band means GPUs to reclaim.

spec.expr: count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}) <= 0.05) or vector(0)

count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}) > 0.05 <= 0.5) or vector(0)

count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}) > 0.5 <= 0.9) or vector(0)

count(max by (host_name, id) (hw_gpu_utilization_ratio{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_gpu_nvidia_mig_instance_id="", host_name=~"$host_name", hw_gpu_model=~"$gpu_model", hw_gpu_task="general"}) > 0.9) or vector(0)

spec.title: Unhealthy NVLink and NVSwitch
spec.description:
NVSwitch chips, their temperatures and the NVLink ports that are not OK right now. Healthy ones are not listed.

Device: the switch, or the port with the GPU and the GPU link at its other end.

Status: Link down when the port's link is down, otherwise Failed or Degraded as the device reports it. An NVSwitch temperature is Degraded at its lower limit and Failed at its upper limit.

spec.expr:
max by (host_name, id, name, hw_type) (
  label_replace(hw_network_up{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", device_type="NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts"} == 0, "hw_type", "network", "", "") + 3
  or 2 * (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|temperature|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state="failed"} == 1)
  or (hw_status{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", hw_type=~"other_device|temperature|network", device_type=~"NVSwitch|NVLink", host_name=~"$model_hosts", state=~"degraded|predicted_failure"} == 1)
  or label_replace(
    (max by (host_name, id, name) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", name=~"NVSwitch.*", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}) >= on (host_name, id) group_left () min by (host_name, id) (hw_temperature_limit_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", name=~"NVSwitch.*", host_name=~"$model_hosts", limit_type="high.critical"})) * 0 + 2
    or (max by (host_name, id, name) (hw_temperature_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", name=~"NVSwitch.*", host_name=~"$model_hosts"}) >= on (host_name, id) group_left () min by (host_name, id) (hw_temperature_limit_celsius{connector_id="NvidiaDCGMExporter", name=~"NVSwitch.*", host_name=~"$model_hosts", limit_type="high.degraded"})) * 0 + 1,
    "hw_type", "temperature", "", ""
  )
)

spec.title: Not Reporting
spec.description:
Number of GPUs the agent knows but that report nothing anymore, for example a card that fell off the bus.

The GPUs Not Reporting table lists them by host, with the state of the connector and the exporter.
